Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 7-K at 4417-4431 W
                              Belmont Ave/3151 N Kenneth Ave - App No. 20601T1
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                       ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICA GO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,

is hereby amended by changing all the Bl-1 Neighborhood Shopping District symbols

and indications as shown on Map No.7-K in the area bounded by


       West Belmont Avenue; a line 109.56 feet east of and parallel to
       North Kenneth Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to
       West Belmont Avenue; and North Kenneth Avenue,


to those of a C2-1 Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District.


SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage
and due publication.



Common Address of Property:         4417-4423 West Belmont Avenue
                       SUBSTITUTE NARRATIVE AND PLANS
                     FOR THE PROPOSED TYPE 1 REZONING
                                               AT
                          4417-31 W. Belmont Ave./3151 N. Kenneth Ave.
                                          31=" Ward

The Applicant intends to change the zoning from the existing Bl-1 to a proposed C2-1 Zoning
District in order to utilize the cunent vacant site as an outdoor contractor's construction storage
yard. This establishment is described as follows:

ZONING: C2-1
LOT AREA: 109.56 x 103.20 x 109.56 xl03.20 = 11,306 square feet
MINIIVIUM LOT AREA PER DWELLING UNIT; N/A - There is an existing contractor's
yard for the storage of construction supplies and equipment (There will be no construction of any
building structure on the lot)
FLOOR AREA RATIO: N/A
BUILDING AREA: N/A - There is an existing contractor's yard for-the storage of construction
supplies and equipment (There will be no construction of any building structure on the lot)
OFF-STREET PARKING: Yes - 5 parking stalls
FRONT SETBACK: N/A
REAR SETBACK: N/A
SIDE SETBACK: N/A
BUILDING HEIGHT: N/A - There is an existing contractor's yard for the storage of
construction supplies and equipment (There will be no construction of any building structure on
the lot)
